title: The Amount This Charter Fixes for an Auto Loans Late Charge, and the Entry That Corrects It
content:
A late charge standing on a loan of the Auto Loans line above the amount this charter fixes for it is put right by one correction entry booked against that charge, for the difference between the amount standing for it and the amount this charter fixes. The remainder of the charge stands.

## 1. The amount standing

1.1 The amount standing for the charge is the amount of the late charge most recently assessed on the loan.

## 2. The amount this charter fixes

2.1 The amount this charter fixes for a late charge is worked out from the scheduled installment in four steps, in this order: the acting base is settled first, the correction percentage is then applied to that base to give the charge before any ceiling, the ceiling is then applied to that figure, and the figure that survives the ceiling is rounded last.

2.2 The acting base is the scheduled installment together with the charges standing unpaid on the loan.

2.3 The correction percentage is 5.0 percent.

2.4 The ceiling is 15.40.

2.5 The figure that survives the ceiling is rounded half-up to the cent.

## 3. The entry

3.1 The correction entry is never more than the amount standing.

3.2 Where the amount standing is no more than the amount this charter fixes, no correction entry is booked at all.

## 4. The clauses applied to hypothetical readings

4.1 Take a loan whose scheduled installment is 412.00 USD and which carries 30.00 USD of charges standing unpaid, with the most recent late charge assessed on it at 25.00 USD.

4.2 The acting base is 412.00 together with 30.00, which is 442.00.

4.3 The correction percentage applied to that base gives 22.10.

4.4 The ceiling holds that figure to 15.40.

4.5 Rounded half-up to the cent, the amount this charter fixes is 15.40.

4.6 The amount standing, 25.00, is greater than 15.40, so one correction entry is booked for the difference, 9.60, and 15.40 of the charge stands.

## 5. Two readings at the edge

5.1 Where the amount standing were instead 15.40, it would be no more than the amount this charter fixes and no entry would be booked.

5.2 Where the charge before the ceiling came to less than the ceiling, the ceiling would take nothing off and that lower figure would be the one rounded.
